about: Where Jerry's music goes (CL-21, CL-23, CL-24, CL-25, D-21; docs/audio/cue-sheet.md). Names are relative to assets/soundtrack/, without .mp3. A pool listed here replaces the default pool in core/audio.js. waveByDay: the track each wave loops, by day (Jerry: days 1-2 day skirmish B, 3-7 A, 8-11 Tier 1, 12-15 Tier 2, 16+ Tier 3; special nights use their day's track until they get their own). fight: the fallback. dayFight: daylight fights pick a track by horde size; sizes[i] is the smallest horde that gets tracks[i]. hits: seconds into a track where it hits (fights start and loop there). stings: cues. gain: loudness multiplier per track (Jerry's are boosted). The aftermath track is out for now (Jerry). The WAV originals stay in incoming/ and are not committed. CL-34 (Jerry): the fight beds are now chiptune loops made by tools/chip.py from the tempo and key of Jerry's Suno fight tracks (chip_*); they loop from 0, natively. The Suno fight files stay on disk until Jerry has heard the loops; the old compose.py metal bed is out of the ember pool. Claude keeps this file.
